chunks: Ali narrated from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from Yazid ibn Khalifah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The time of dawn is when it appears until it brightens.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: Dawn, specifically referring to the time for the morning prayer

ai.seo_question: What is the defined time range for the Fajr prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Shaykh al-Tusi records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) to clarify the precise boundaries of the Fajr prayer window, distinguishing the initial appearance of dawn (al-fajr al-sadiq) from the full brightening of the sky. This definition is crucial in Shia jurisprudence for determining the start of the prayer time and its conclusion before the sun rises, ensuring the prayer is performed within its valid temporal limits.
